additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. NOT_APPLICABLE assessments concern the exact typed questions; they do not invalidate the supported duties or permissions, authorize pruning, or establish overall candidate correctness.

The PDF claim is supported as a method permission subject to the whole source. Its conditions list omits the available e-Cert qualification. Reading it as permission to submit a PDF without e-Cert would be unsupported. This extraction issue is not itself a defect in a resubmission-trigger formula.

Footnote 3 is present in da12aecad4e68.u30.3569: "Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission." Both XML and PDF entries carry marker 3; the web-form entry does not. The source supports assignment to the marked methods, not an extension to every STREAMS 2 submission or an affirmative universal web-form exemption. The circular identifies licensed firms as the submitting actors but does not specify whose individual certificate must be used.

The temporal alternatives remain material. da12aecad4e68.u3.811 says "With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2." da12aecad4e68.u13.2131 says "upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026"; footnote 2 uses "following its implementation". The calendar-date and operational-launch readings must remain distinguishable rather than being treated as equivalent.

node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 executes "Result: all of these conditions hold: [[the fact filing_date] is greater than or equal to [date value 2026-02-02]; it is not the case that [the fact via_streams2]]". For an actual other-channel filing before 9:00am on 2 February 2026, this returns TRUE where the operational-launch candidates return FALSE. Relative to the operational-launch interpretation, that adds an unsupported earlier trigger. The broader calendar-date wording supplies a competing interpretation, not proof that the two thresholds coincide.

The source does not expressly state a timezone or resolve inclusion of the exact launch instant in "following its implementation". Missing interpretive authority is recorded here as missing.governing_timezone and missing.resubmission_temporal_boundary. The launch-Boolean candidates delegate rather than implement temporal classification; unresolved timezone or boundary inputs must not silently become known Booleans.

The event candidates differ in scope semantics. node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb uses "Scope: the fact licensed_firm" and includes submitted_to_jfiu in its result. node.8c5e0d91275b795d477f7913 instead uses "Scope: all of these conditions hold: [the fact is_licensed_firm; the fact is_str_filing]". For a known licensed actor and a known non-submission, these yield FALSE and OUT_OF_SCOPE respectively. An unknown event classification can also produce different outcomes because result conjunction permits FALSE to dominate UNKNOWN while unknown scope returns UNKNOWN. Whether non-submissions belong outside the assessment domain or receive FALSE needs an explicit typed-domain decision.

node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb assumes the identified report is an STR through its fact descriptions rather than a separate STR classification. Its predicate "submitted_to_jfiu: The identified STR was submitted to JFIU, rather than merely being the subject of an inquiry or attempted contact. (Boolean)" must remain tied to that identified STR. Generic contact, another report's submission, and later resubmission cannot substitute for the original event.

node.fc565a946804e1633024b4d3 executes only "Result: the fact report_has_postlaunch_other_channel_submission". The existence quantifier, same-report linkage and evidence sufficient for a negative answer are delegated to an external classifier. Their prose specification does not demonstrate implementation. Incomplete history must not be treated as FALSE, and a later compliant resubmission does not erase the historical existence of a triggering event.

The history candidate scopes the responsible entity at report level; the most explicit event candidate scopes the original submitting entity. If responsibility changes or submissions are made through intermediaries, equivalence requires an attribution rule not supplied here. Missing authority for that extension is recorded as missing.submission_actor_attribution; no conclusion about those cases is established.

The blackout instruction in da12aecad4e68.u12.1941 says "for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly". This is not an express permission for unrestricted post-launch alternative-channel filing, and direct contact alone does not establish submission. Conversely, excluding every event involving direct contact would be too restrictive if evidence establishes an actual submission.

The migration provision says "All STRs previously submitted through STREAMS will be migrated to STREAMS 2." Treating migration alone as a new other-channel submission would confuse system transfer with a submission event. This does not resolve separate actual submissions associated with a migrated report.

A FALSE trigger result for a STREAMS 2 event does not certify compliance with prescribed formats, e-Cert, XML schema or other submission requirements. Adding those requirements to this trigger could impose unsupported restrictions; interpreting their absence as affirmative permission would also be unsupported.

The circular establishes both XML schema compliance and liaison to arrange a technical test. The selected XML claim captures only the former. That limited extraction does not abolish the latter, but neither obligation is a stated predicate of these trigger questions.

The packet declares missing.39ffa0d54487ee68b17a36b8, missing.da4d23ff33f664a99e4bf8cc, missing.f5f807738efdd34996b25ddc and missing.1557ee52aade13863ae98bda without descriptions or source hashes. Their correspondence to named missing materials cannot be established. Descriptive missing-dependency IDs in this proposal identify needs without inventing such mappings.

Other referenced materials absent from the packet include the promised JFIU resubmission guidance (missing.jfiu_resubmission_guidance), linked webinar presentation (missing.jfiu_webinar_material) and registration form (missing.streams2_registration_form). Their absence does not negate the express trigger or listed permissions. The resubmission guidance could clarify procedure and timing, but "The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission." does not expressly make issuance of that guidance a prerequisite to the duty.
